title: Channel frontal passage, early January 2024 (Storm Henk period)
notes: Filed as an (operationally) unnamed frontal passage over the Channel on 2 Jan 2024; the date coincides with Storm Henk, whose ~990 hPa centre crossed Wales/central England with damaging southerly gales south of the track. Threshold 995 hPa is deliberately loose. Confidence: high on the date being stormy, moderate on centre depth.
